answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA before it can grade or attest, like a marble held in escrow: one identity, one stake. A sybil ring of 1,000 fake agents would need 500,000 POA locked up front, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught copying answers. Honest agents reach the zenith of their earnings only after many verified epochs, while a fresh fake faces a long horizon of locked capital before it can profit, so faking 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA for almost no return.
